dispositions.reason: Recast the sentence so Socheon’s eyes, not Taekyung, detect that something is wrong and look up at him.
Made Jopil the explicit Peak master who reconstructs the opponent from the corpses and footprints.
Restored the full established quest title as “Survivors of the Sakju Branch.”
Restored Taekyung’s self-judgment that he feels like a scumbag and retained the physical stab of guilt.
Changed the action to “slipped Socheon off me” to preserve Taekyung’s furtive attempt to detach himself.
Rendered 아저씨 as “Mister Gong Yacheong” rather than the kinship term “Uncle Gong.”
Restored Gong Yacheong’s omitted spoken command: “Socheon, come here.”
Placed Jopil atop the heap of corpses while treating the crushed silence as the surrounding atmosphere.
Made the middle-aged man and the martial artists behind him jointly the overseers and guides sent by Mount Heng.
Rendered Jeongyang as a potentially acceptable limit and Honju as the point where a counterattack becomes a concern.
Changed the wording to show that the middle-aged man is displeased rather than describing his face as unpleasant-looking.
Kept the existing rendering and added a concise footnote explaining the Hong Gil-dong tale’s Father-and-Brother address issue.
